title: Claude Code Handoff File: Never Lose Context Again
description:
Context window full and your AI agent forgets everything? 🧠

✅ Save a HANDOFF.md note with what is done and what is next
✅ Start a fresh claude -p session that reads it
✅ Watch the new window pick up where the last one stopped

Day 9 of Agent Harness. Next up: Day 10, Score Harness Changes on a Benchmark.
Follow for a new short every day and build AI agents you can trust.

#shorts #claudecode #aicoding #aiagents #aitools #coding #programming
comment: Handoff file or resume: which would you try first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: keep the note short and specific, like what is done, what is next and anything blocked, so the fresh session can act on it.
